description: On the green-covered surface in front of you are several small, brightly colored plastic plates: yellow, red, blue, and green. The right hand reaches in from the lower right, grips the blue plate and slides it leftward to separate it, then moves to the green plate, lifts it, places it on top of the blue plate, and finally slides the stacked pair rightward to sit on the red plate, forming a stack while the hand releases.
